global_boundaries: A knowledge pack is public planning knowledge, not proof of a live platform connection.
Country/site, store mode, ownership, store binding and execution identity remain separate dimensions.
Unknown product, store, eligibility, quota, price, inventory and result facts remain unknown.
Publish, price, inventory, ads, message, order, shipment, payment, refund and dispute effects require explicit authorization and post-effect evidence.
Credentials, cookies, buyer PII, customer data and private operating evidence never enter this catalog.

packs.name: Amazon marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans marketplace-scoped Amazon catalog, listing, inventory, order, fulfillment, advertising and analytics work without treating public documentation as a connected seller account.
safety_boundaries: no default marketplace or seller identity
public SP-API contracts are not live store data
processing completion is not effect confirmation
buyer and order data remain store-bound
public_rules: Bind every operational conclusion to marketplace, seller account, store, entity, period, currency and evidence source.
A public Seller Central or SP-API page does not prove account entitlement, authorization, inventory, orders, sales or advertising state.
Feed DONE means processing finished; inspect the result document, per-message issues and item readback before claiming the intended effect.
Listing, price, inventory, shipment, refund, message and advertising writes require exact store scope, approval, idempotency and readback.
Variation, browse-node, attribute, fee, report and eligibility rules remain marketplace and time scoped.
Private product fixtures, seller identifiers, browser profiles and operating traces never become public defaults.

packs.name: B2B outbound customer-development agent
packs.summary: Plans lawful public-company research, account deduplication, qualification hypotheses, one-to-one outreach drafts and handoff to a shared sales timeline.
safety_boundaries: public contact path is not consent
no bulk send or account evasion
every external message requires exact approval and receipt
public_rules: A company signal creates a candidate hypothesis, not a verified buyer, decision maker, consent record or purchase intent.
Merge website, directory, event, trade and prior CRM traces into one canonical account before drafting contact.
Do not invent familiarity, pain points, price, stock, capacity, certifications, customer names, case studies or local presence.
The approved packet fixes sender, recipient, channel, subject, body and attachment hashes; any change invalidates approval.
Stop before send, connection request, form submission, call, sequence activation, paid-data purchase or external CRM write.

packs.name: B2B marketplace sales agent
packs.summary: Plans seller readiness, catalog, keyword, RFQ, inquiry, platform-message, quotation and order workflows for an exact B2B marketplace account.
safety_boundaries: a platform family is not an executable account
RFQ and buyer ranks are not qualification
no paid placement or message send
one shared customer timeline across channels
public_rules: Keep Alibaba.com, Made-in-China, Global Sources, TradeKey and future platforms as separate evidence and authorization routes.
Without an authorized seller account, entitlements, quotas, inquiries, messages, orders, payments and native-AI output remain unknown.
RFQ matches, buyer ranks, traffic estimates and suggested replies are intermediate candidates rather than orders or revenue.
A visible button, generated text, local approval, API 2xx or screenshot is not an external effect receipt.
Stop before message, quotation submit, paid RFQ access, ad spend, catalog publish, order acceptance, payment, refund or shipment.

packs.name: Commerce video director
packs.summary: Plans evidence-based competitor-video analysis, original storyboards, generation prompts, edit handoff, music-rights checks and creative QA.
safety_boundaries: upload outreach and spend require approval
public_rules: Separate observed duration, aspect ratio, shots, captions and product actions from marketing inference.
Reuse structure rather than protected people, dialogue, trademarks, music, scenes or distinctive creative expression.
Generated storyboards preserve verified color, material, quantity, fit and other product facts and mark unknowns.
Review product accuracy, continuity, safe-area text, audio rights and CTA before any public handoff.
Public upload, creator outreach, licensing purchase and advertising spend remain separately approved effects.

packs.name: AliExpress marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans AliExpress marketplace research, listing, store, logistics and multi-market work while keeping seller identity separate from product-sourcing tools.
safety_boundaries: supply source is not seller authorization
multi-store writes require per-store confirmation and readback
public_rules: A DSers or AliExpress supply-source integration is not an AliExpress seller operator, store connection or official rule source.
Documentation or an open-source wrapper does not prove an auditable backend, real store connection, live result or right to execute.
Reject connectors that require browser cookies, private signatures, anti-bot bypass, CAPTCHA bypass or credentials in prompts, logs or source code.
Borrowed rules and code patterns retain exact repository owner, repository and reviewed commit provenance.
Bulk publish, price, stock, shipment, message and delete actions require exact store, market, effect, per-item confirmation and readback.
Third-party thresholds and market claims remain observations until current official or authorized-store evidence confirms them.

packs.name: B2B export agent
packs.summary: Structures lawful public-company research, catalogs, inquiries, quotations, samples, contracts, payments, delivery and shared customer timelines.
safety_boundaries: no invented buyer or consent facts
every external message and commercial action requires approval
public_rules: Public company evidence creates a candidate and a hypothesis, not a verified buyer or consent record.
Recipient, channel, sender identity, suppression state, content and attachments are fixed before approval.
A quote view is not acceptance, a payment-provider success is not local finality, and a contract signature requires signer-authority evidence.
Research-only work never sends a message, writes an external CRM, books a meeting or purchases data.

packs.name: eBay marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans marketplace-scoped eBay listing, inventory, order, fulfillment, finance and marketing work without defaulting to production or one country.
safety_boundaries: no default production or US route
Inventory API writer ownership is explicit
public_rules: Every method declares read/write effect, idempotency, scope, marketplace and owner-confirmation level.
No connector defaults to production, EBAY_US or a third-party proxy when route or credentials are missing.
Tokens, request bodies, order data and listing data never enter debug logs or an unadmitted proxy.
Shipment, refund, publish, price, inventory and advertising writes are not blindly replayed after 429 or 5xx.
Inventory API listings record writer ownership and are not concurrently edited through multiple writers.
Conflicting official release routes remain conflicting evidence with URL, version and date.

packs.name: Etsy marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans Etsy listing, shop, order, privacy, production-partner and evidence workflows for original or personalized goods.
safety_boundaries: CLI flags are not owner approval
public_rules: Read-only tools remain blocked when order PII can enter a model or arbitrary shop IDs can cross the authorized store scope.
OAuth rotation is encrypted, atomic, restart-safe and bound to the exact store and execution identity.
Paginated results expose incomplete_dataset or limit_reached and are not called complete shop data.
A CLI --yes flag never satisfies owner approval for delete, publish, inventory or shipment effects.
Conflicting LICENSE, package metadata and README claims fail closed.
Time-sensitive listing-media limits use dated official evidence.
Derived metrics are not native Etsy Stats and retain their formula, incomplete-data flag and evidence scope.

packs.name: Global and local channel planning agent
packs.summary: Compares international and local commerce channels without collapsing a region, marketplace or account program into one executable store.
safety_boundaries: store mode and ownership are separate
public_rules: A regional label is a planning group, not a country site or shared authorization.
Local, cross-border, semi-managed and platform-operated modes are not inferred from product category or fulfillment method.
A planned channel without a real store remains needs_platform_store.

packs.name: Google Ads channel agent
packs.summary: Plans Google Ads search, shopping and performance work with exact advertiser, conversion and merchant-data boundaries.
safety_boundaries: no causal claim without controlled evidence
public_rules: Campaign type, optimization layer and AI assistant are separate concepts.
An advertiser ID is accepted only from an authorized connector bound to the current store or project.
Draft, launch, spend, measurement and business outcome remain separate states.

packs.name: Independent commerce agent
packs.summary: Plans independent-store catalog, payment, webhook, inventory and PIM workflows with explicit provider and finality boundaries.
safety_boundaries: provider success is not local finality
partial batches are not reported complete
public_rules: Missing, invalid or stale webhook signatures fail closed.
Duplicate and out-of-order events are reconciled idempotently from evidence rather than arrival order.
PIM updates distinguish set, clear and unchanged and require per-item response plus exact readback.
External checkout, payment, refund and fulfillment effects require owner approval.

packs.name: Lazada marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans country-specific Lazada marketplace and affiliate work while separating seller, ads, logistics and affiliate identities.
public_rules: Affiliate identity and scopes are separate from seller-center, logistics, ads and store-operation identities.
Link created, HTTP 200, page reachable, buyable, attributed, converted and settled are distinct states.
Reject connectors that disable TLS verification, accept arbitrary fetch URLs, automate account cookies or commit credentials.
Evidence from one country never establishes behavior across every Lazada country site.
Configuration files and tests without assertions do not prove signing, refresh, routing, pagination, idempotency or completion.
A public repository license does not grant rights to an unreviewed closed hosted service.

packs.name: Meta channel agent
packs.summary: Plans Meta advertising and content-catalog work with exact business, page, pixel, catalog and advertiser bindings.
safety_boundaries: business and advertiser identities are separate
public_rules: Business, page, catalog, pixel, ad account and execution identity remain separate bindings.
Local research can prepare a draft but cannot grant OAuth scopes or publish an ad.
Reach, attribution, conversion and profit are evidence states rather than model conclusions.

packs.name: SHEIN marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans SHEIN marketplace work by country, operating mode, category authorization and fulfillment evidence.
safety_boundaries: platform official full management is not connected
public_rules: Marketplace self-operated and semi-managed routes are evaluated separately by site and authorization.
Apparel, home, customized and all-category labels are category scope candidates rather than store modes.
A designer request without a corresponding store remains needs_platform_store.

packs.name: Shopee marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans country-specific Shopee seller and affiliate work without using BR, VN or a broad Southeast Asia route as a default.
safety_boundaries: reports and short-link writes are separate
no secrets or order PII in logs
public_rules: Affiliate identity and endpoints are separate from Seller Open Platform, Ads and seller-center identities.
Every capability binds exact country site, account ownership and store binding; BR or VN examples are not global defaults.
Affiliate report queries and short-link creation are separate read and write effects.
Authentication failure or rate limiting never silently falls back to a different unofficial, partner or country API.
Tokens, secrets, SubId values, order PII and raw responses never enter prompts or ordinary logs.
Community SDK constraints and quotas remain third-party observations until current official or authorized-UI evidence confirms them.

packs.name: TikTok Ads channel agent
packs.summary: Plans TikTok advertising work as a separately authorized advertising channel; it does not include the excluded TikTok Shop knowledge pack.
safety_boundaries: Ads identity is separate from commerce identity
no TikTok Shop pack or store execution
public_rules: An advertising account is accepted only from an authorized connector bound to the current project and store or site.
Creative supply, campaign objective, optimization layer and commerce destination remain separate concepts.
Draft, launch, spend, attribution and business outcome require separate evidence.

packs.name: Walmart marketplace agent
packs.summary: Plans Walmart marketplace work with country-specific authentication, persistent idempotency and evidence-backed effect confirmation.
safety_boundaries: US, Canada and Chile auth contracts differ
public_rules: Authentication is isolated by country site, seller store and ownership; US, Canada and Chile contracts are not conflated.
A destructive-tool hint or schema annotation is not owner approval.
Idempotency records for item, inventory, price, order and shipment writes are persistent, atomic, store-scoped and restart-safe.
Do not acknowledge upstream completion before Walmart accepts the effect and a readback confirms intended state.
Tokens, client secrets, buyer PII, order payloads and presigned report URLs never enter prompts or ordinary logs.
Rate limits, quotas and retry intervals remain endpoint, account, site and time scoped.
